plotSections.title: Searching for the Lich's Phylactery
bullets: The party continues testing items for possible soul fragments or phylactery properties after dinner at the stronghold.

The hunched eagle marker Walker brought back from Grixto's hideout was tested and came back clean: no soul fragment or phylactery-like properties, staying dormant longer than the helm did without any reaction. It is crossed off the list.
Walker has nothing else in his inventory that could have belonged to the 'emperor'. Dana and the others mostly hold items from the white dragon's hoard.
Ord mentions his turquoise animal figurines but believes they came from the Sunder Chase, so they are unlikely to be relevant.
Sylan proposes using the fused lantern-staff, which Ord previously used to see souls attached to objects, to find which soul is attached to the helm.

plotSections.title: Examining the Lantern-Staff
bullets: Sylan asks Ord for the activation phrase (the 'Seeker passphrase'). Ord's player can't recall it immediately because his notes are not accessible.
Dana has no Identify or Detect Magic but has strong Arcana, and inspects the lantern-staff with a 22.

The staff looks like a shepherd's crook or hook with a lantern on the end. It is made of very hardy wood and gives off a palpable magical presence, visible in how the light catches it. It is definitely magical in nature.

chronologicalEvents: After dinner, the DM recaps that the hunched eagle marker from Grixto's hideout tested clean: no phylactery properties.
Walker confirms he has no other items that might have belonged to the emperor.
Ord notes his turquoise animal figurines but suspects they came from the Sunder Chase.
Sylan recalls a shark statuette that became a real shark via a magic word. Gerk says he has it, and Sylan suggests the figurines might work similarly.
Sylan suggests using the lantern-staff to see which soul is attached to the helm, and asks Ord for the Seeker passphrase.
Dana inspects the lantern-staff with a 22 Arcana check and confirms it is a hardy wooden shepherd's crook with a lantern and strong magic.
